'''November 2000 St. Cloud tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at St. Cloud State University (Atwood Center), St. Cloud, Minnesota on 18 November 2000. It is known from Robert Parker's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1470">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-19-saint-cloud-mn-11-18-00d1470/ saint-cloud-mn-11-18-00], DeckTech (Robert "Sparky" Parker, 19 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-19-saint-cloud-mn-11-18-00d1470/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 November 2000
* '''Site:''' St. Cloud State University (Atwood Center), St. Cloud, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 31
* '''Winner:''' [[Joshua Grace]]<ref name="tr-d1482" />

== Tournament reports ==

Players' own reports from this event.

* [[Robert Parker Saint Cloud MN 11-18-00 (tournament report)]] — by [[Robert Parker]], 9th, 4–2
* [[Joshua Grace Where's My Monnok The Full Report Mix (tournament report)]] — by [[Joshua Grace]], 1st, 5–1

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Robert Parker says he finished 9th out of 31 players; Joshua Grace (d1482) says the tournament drew 32 players ('the 31 players other than myself').<ref name="tr-d1470" />
* Joshua Grace says the tournament drew 32 players; Robert Parker (d1470) says he finished 9th out of 31.<ref name="tr-d1482" />
